visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with reddish-brown hair, wearing a white Los Angeles Dodgers baseball jersey (number 56) and loose light-blue jeans, stands on a stage holding a microphone. The background consists of a wall repeating the logos of 'MLB PRO SPIRIT' and 'KONAMI' in a grid pattern. He is speaking and laughing. (2) The scene transitions to a digital montage showing mobile game player cards with stylized action photography of baseball players. A large yellow text banner appears in the center. (3) Back to the stage, the man (Kuo Hung-chih) stands next to a large digital screen displaying a biography and detailed statistics in a game-style UI. He points at the screen while addressing the audience. (4) The screen shows a gameplay interface of 'MLB PRO SPIRIT' with specific attributes for a pitcher, including an 'OVR 89' rating and pitch types like 'A' grade fastballs. (5) Kuo pulls a black cloth off a large standing poster of his own game character card. He gestures towards it with his microphone hand while smiling. (6) A pre-recorded video of another man, Saito Takashi, wearing a white shirt and speaking from an indoor setting with wood-paneled walls, appears on a screen. He waves and speaks to the camera. (7) Kuo is seen sitting in a chair on stage, laughing during a talk show segment. Variety-show style text and laughing emojis appear as overlays. (8) A man in a blue baseball jersey (Tainan Josh) and a woman in a black top (LaiKi) are shown on stage. They are using their smartphones to play the game, which is also being mirrored on a large screen behind them. (9) Close-up shots of the mobile game show a CG pitcher on a stadium mound. Icons and touch controls are visible on the screen interface. (10) Kuo stands on stage holding a large prop that looks like a smartphone displaying the game's home screen with the text 'DOWNLOAD NOW!' and a 'KONAMI' logo.
